thesis: Mixed alchemical, mechanical and religious histories must be understood without treating every inherited belief as validated.

ideas.statement: Van Helmont, Boyle and Pasteur illustrate fruitful work within mixed worldviews; mechanism can coexist with faith and experimental results do not travel with entire spiritual systems.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Van Helmont’s gas work is not mature modern carbon dioxide theory; Pasteur’s bounded spontaneous-generation results do not refute all origin-of-life hypotheses, and anecdotes remain unauthenticated.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Van Helmont’s gas work is not mature modern carbon dioxide theory; Pasteur’s bounded spontaneous-generation results do not refute all origin-of-life hypotheses, and anecdotes remain unauthenticated.

audit.notes: All batch source units read; scientific propositions separated from philosophical interpretations and documentary limits.
